# lelam.co

> lelam.co is an online curated peer-to-peer pre-loved fashion and thrift clothing marketplace with live daily auctions across India.

## About Lelam
"Lelam" means Auction in Malayalam. Lelam connects people across India to buy and sell unique pre-owned fashion, vintage pieces, streetwear, and designer thrift with door-to-door courier tracking and safe escrow payments.

## Core Features

### 1. Buying
- **Buy Now**: Purchase instantly at the listed asking price.
- **Private Offers**: Buyers can make confidential price offers directly to sellers; sellers can accept, decline, or counter without public haggling.
- **Daily Live Auctions**:
  - Curated listings enter timed daily auctions.
  - Bidding is live and anonymous (using pseudonyms).
  - Anti-sniping protection: Any bid placed in the final 30 seconds automatically extends the auction clock by 30 seconds.
  - Winning bids are binding commitments with a 10-minute payment window.

### 2. Transparent Pricing & Fees
- **Buyer Fees**:
  - Item price + delivery fee.
  - Platform fee: Flat ₹10 + 18% GST (₹11.80 total platform fee).
  - Payment methods: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards, Netbanking, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
- **Seller Fees**:
  - Flat 10% commission on the final selling price (GST inclusive).
  - Sellers keep 90% of their sale.
  - Free doorstep courier pickup across India.

### 3. Trust, Safety & Escrow Protection
- **Doorstep Delivery**: Tracked couriers across Indian postal PIN codes with automated address verification.
- **3-Day Inspection Window**: Buyer payments are safely held in escrow until doorstep delivery and a 3-day inspection window closes.
- **Buyer Protection**: Full refunds if items arrive damaged, counterfeit, or materially not as described.
